'''1999 Outer Rim Regionals Aldrin Long DS''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on Decipher Deck Designs.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Aldrin Long]]
* '''Event:''' [[1999 Outer Rim Regionals]]
* '''Stage:''' Published lists
* '''Finish:''' 1st
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|ISB Operations / Empire's Sinister Agents|SE-D-isboperations.gif|label=ISB Operations}}
* '''Strategy:''' ISB Operations
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PEndor ISB Long DS 1999 OuterRim.txt |Download]]

== Strategy ==

Aldrin became the first-ever World Championship qualifier from Singapore with his Open Championship victory.
